lessonRef.subject: ready-for-life
lessonRef.unitTitle: Taking Care of My Own Space
lessonRef.title: Mastery check: right-size jobs

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy Ready for Life elementary sequence — Grade 3
Ready for Life v1 safety, supervision, and no-shame policy reference
Manuel Academy RFL G3 Unit 1 — personal and shared space care
Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can practice right-size jobs. I will do one step at a time and check one result.
scenario: A trusted adult writes three job cards of different sizes for a real space, such as straightening the books on one shelf, clearing off a desk and filing the papers in a tray, or emptying a closet floor and sorting items into keep, donate, and trash.
safetyNotes: If the fifteen-minute job involves anything heavier than the learner can lift with one hand, such as a full box or a stacked bin, the trusted adult lifts or moves it, not the learner.
The adult confirms the finished job against the specific "done" standard written on the chosen job card before marking it complete, rather than accepting "I'm done" on its own.

simulationAlternative.description: If the learner does not have a real space with three distinguishable job sizes available today, they instead read three written job-card descriptions, choose which one best fits their current time and energy, and write a step-by-step plan for completing it, including the specific 'done' standard for that job size.

materials: learner-local: the specific supplies each job needs, such as a donation bag or a paper tray

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u01-l05-model-card. Watch one complete example.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u01-l05-guided-card. Do the coached move.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u01-l05-independent-card. Choose one complete route. Follow its steps.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u01-l05-evidence-record. Save one result and one reflection.

prompts.text: Describe one specific moment during the job when you were tempted to switch to a different-sized job instead, and what made you stick with the size you chose.

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l05-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l05-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g3-u01-l05-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Right-sizing judgment: Picks a job size that reasonably matches the stated time and energy. | Full completion: The job is fully completed and meets the done standard for its size, confirmed by the adult. | Reflection specificity: The reflection names a specific moment of temptation to change job size. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l05-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner write three of their own right-sized job cards for a different space, such as the kitchen counter or the entryway, including a specific done standard for each size, and choose one to complete.

resources.title: right-size jobs worked model
resources.purpose: Shows the starting condition, visible moves, reasoning, and success check before the learner begins.
content: Starting condition: A trusted adult writes three job cards of different sizes for a real space, such as straightening the books on one shelf, clearing off a desk and filing the papers in a tray, or emptying a closet floor and sorting items into keep, donate, and trash.
Model move 1: Read the condition and name the exact right-size jobs decision or action.
Model move 2: Read all three job cards before choosing.
Model move 3: Choose the job card that honestly matches your time and energy, tell your adult which one you picked and why, and gather what you need before starting.

Model check: Right-sizing judgment: Picks a job size that reasonably matches the stated time and energy. | Full completion: The job is fully completed and meets the done standard for its size, confirmed by the adult. | Reflection specificity: The reflection names a specific moment of temptation to change job size.

resources.title: right-size jobs action steps
resources.purpose: Provides the ordered directions used by the model, guided attempt, independent task, and retry.
content: 1. Read the goal for right-size jobs.
2. Watch the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l05-model-card.
3. Do one coached move on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l05-guided-card.
4. Complete the chosen route on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l05-independent-card.
5. Save the small record on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l05-evidence-record; use swk-rfl-g3-u01-l05-retry-pair if a step is missed.

resources.title: right-size jobs coached first attempt
resources.purpose: Carries the complete first attempt and a fresh correction turn.
content: Fictional practice condition: A trusted adult writes three job cards of different sizes for a real space, such as straightening the books on one shelf, clearing off a desk and filing the papers in a tray, or emptying a closet floor and sorting items into keep, donate, and trash.
Coach direction: Read all three job cards before choosing.
Learner prompt: After reading all three job cards, write down how much time and energy you realistically have right now.
Feedback check: name the move completed, point to the matching success check, and identify one missing or uncertain step without judging the learner.
Fresh correction turn: use the same fictional condition with one constraint changed; restate the changed constraint, redo only the affected step, and check the new result.

resources.title: right-size jobs complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Choose the job card that honestly matches your time and energy, tell your adult which one you picked and why, and gather what you need before starting.
Response 1 (t2-p1): I read all three job-size options before choosing one.
Response 2 (t2-p2): I chose the job size that honestly matches my time and energy today, not the biggest one to impress someone or the smallest one to avoid work.
Response 3 (t2-p3): I told my adult which job I chose and why, before starting.
Response 4 (t2-p4): I gathered anything I needed, such as a donation bag or a paper tray, before starting the job.

Equal-access rule: If the learner does not have a real space with three distinguishable job sizes available today, they instead read three written job-card descriptions, choose which one best fits their current time and energy, and write a step-by-step plan for completing it, including the specific 'done' standard for that job size.

resources.title: right-size jobs minimal evidence record
resources.purpose: Defines exactly what the learner saves and what must not be collected.
content: Record only: selected route, completed step numbers, one non-sensitive result statement, and one revision if a step changed.
Reflection: Describe one specific moment during the job when you were tempted to switch to a different-sized job instead, and what made you stick with the size you chose.

Success checks: Right-sizing judgment: Picks a job size that reasonably matches the stated time and energy. | Full completion: The job is fully completed and meets the done standard for its size, confirmed by the adult. | Reflection specificity: The reflection names a specific moment of temptation to change job size.
Do not collect: names, signatures, addresses, or exact locations; account, identification, medical, product, or medicine details; photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules.

resources.title: right-size jobs supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l05-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g3-u01-l05-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional right-size jobs condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Right-sizing judgment: Picks a job size that reasonably matches the stated time and energy. | Full completion: The job is fully completed and meets the done standard for its size, confirmed by the adult. | Reflection specificity: The reflection names a specific moment of temptation to change job size..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l05-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

realRoute.title: right-size jobs — permitted real-life route
realRoute.permissionRule: Do not begin the physical action until a household-authorized guardian gives permission and is available for the supervision or review named in this lesson.
steps: Confirm the setting, materials, and stop condition before acting.
Choose the job card that honestly matches your time and energy, tell your adult which one you picked and why, and gather what you need before starting.
Complete the response prompts on the delivered independent card without recording private identifying details.
Check the result against the delivered evidence record and correct any missed step.
realRoute.completionCondition: The learner submits the minimal process record; only the household-authorized guardian attests that the named physical action occurred.

retry.trigger: Start the correction loop when a required step is missing, the reason does not match the condition, a safety or privacy boundary is crossed, or the evidence does not show the stated result.
retry.targetedReteach: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l05-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step.
retry.supportedReattempt: Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g3-u01-l05-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check.
retry.feedback: Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments.
retry.parallelReattempt: Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g3-u01-l05-retry-pair without the coach prompt.
retry.exitCriterion: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Right-sizing judgment: Picks a job size that reasonably matches the stated time and energy. | Full completion: The job is fully completed and meets the done standard for its size, confirmed by the adult. | Reflection specificity: The reflection names a specific moment of temptation to change job size.

guardianInvolvement.role: Give permission; provide only the supervision, handling, review, or observation named in the lesson; attest only that the physical event occurred.
guardianInvolvement.signOffBoundary: A guardian attestation certifies only that the named physical event occurred. It never scores the learner reflection or proves effort, honesty, maturity, responsibility, diagnosis, or character.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.
safety.physicalBoundary: The learner follows the source safety notes and never performs adult-only handling, transport, account, legal, medical, heat, sharp-tool, electrical, chemical, or machine actions.
safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.

privacy.rule: Collect the smallest process record that shows the lesson steps. A learner may choose fictional details and may decline private disclosure without losing credit.

photos, audio, video, passwords, or private household schedules

may: coach the guided and retry cards
mayNot: observe or claim a physical condition
tutorBoundary.physicalCompletionRule: Tutor or AI may coach. Tutor or AI may not certify that a real-world physical action occurred.
tutorBoundary.missingResourceAction: Stop and name the unresolved resource. Do not fabricate it; use another complete delivered route only when every resource for that route resolves.
